children: NextBoat appoints Zebulon Hadley to its board and names Todd Bates VP of Finance & Insurance, strengthening governance and revenue leadership.
Zebulon Hadley joins the board as an independent director and will chair the Compensation Committee, enhancing governance.
Hadley built National Coatings to roughly $39 million in annual revenue and brings 20 years of entrepreneurial scaling experience.
Todd Bates appointed VP of Finance & Insurance after driving over $5M of F&I revenue across 80 locations in his prior role.
Company says additions support NextBoat’s next phase of growth as it scales its vertically integrated marine marketplace.
